name: Sheet header
summary: The top of Front Door's sheet: back, “Atmosphere account” with the mark, and close.

when: At the top of every step in Front Door's sheet.

anatomy.description: An icon button, from the second step on. Its arrow mirrors right to left.

props.name: back
props.description: Shows the back button, from the second step on.

events.name: doras-back
events.when: Back is pressed. The app goes to the previous step and moves focus to its heading.

events.name: doras-close
events.when: Close is pressed. The sheet closes and returns focus to whatever opened it.

accessibility.role: banner of the sheet, with two buttons
accessibility.name: The buttons are named “Back” and “Close”.

keyboard.action: Closes the sheet; the sheet handles it (#14).

screenReader: Back and close are announced as buttons with their names. The brand is read as text.
notes: After moving back or forward, focus goes to the new step's heading, so screen readers start from the top.

related.relationship: Its container, which handles focus and Escape.

guidelines: The brand always says “Atmosphere account”, never the app's name.

dosAndDonts.do: Show back from the second step on.
dosAndDonts.dont: Show back on the first step.

evidence.point: Focus moves to each new step's heading, so screen reader users know the step changed (prototype).
